solution.text:
(i) The magnetic field at the centre due to the curved portion DA=μ0i4πR 3π2

According to the right-hand screw rule, the magnetic field will be into the plane of the paper.



(ii) The magnetic field at M due to AB is zero.

(iii) The magnetic field at the centre due to the curved portion BC is μ0i4π2R π2.

According to the right-hand screw rule, the magnetic field will be into the plane of the paper.

(iv) The magnetic field at M due to DC is zero.

Hence, the resultant magnetic field at M

BM=Bsmall loop+Bbig loop 

Both are perpendicular downward

BM=μOi4πR32π+μOi4π2Rπ2 

BM=716μOiR  ⨂
